lines.en: My broad body presses forward.
I swing my tail slowly in the murk.
I squeeze between the waterweeds.
I leave a groove in the muddy bottom.
My fins cut the surface.
The water in this pool isn't deep.
I swim along the rotten mud of the bank.
I surface and take a breath.
Bubbles surface in a chain.
I sink back down.
I swim past a fallen trunk.
A body this size doesn't get pushed.
I slowly change my heading.
The surface parts around me.
I hang still in the cloudy water.
This thick hide fits tight to me.
I open my mouth and close it.
The stones on the bottom are still.
Something keeps moving over there.

lines.zh: 我眨了一下厚重的眼皮。
lines.en: I blink my heavy eyelids once.
I settle down onto the mud.
The smell of this water is mixed.
My tail tapped lightly.
Insects scatter off the surface.
I hadn't intended to move at all.
I'm listening for movement on the bank.
A string of bubbles rises from the mud.
The water only reaches your knees.

lines.zh: 我把宽脑袋转过来，看着你。
lines.en: I turn my broad head and look at you.
This fish is broader than you are.
I hadn't planned on starting anything.
Only my back shows above the surface.
We stay still for a moment.
My fins are spread below the water.

lines.zh: 别紧张，我只是在打量你。
lines.en: Relax. I'm only sizing you up.
I rolled over a little.
That made me pull back.
There's a gash in my thick hide.
I churned the water even murkier.
I steadied myself slowly.
That means little to me.
Red blooms out through the water.
A white scratch is left on my thick scales.
I can still move in the water.
That thing isn't a fish.
I only eat what's in the water.
Set it down on the water.
It's still a little far from me.

lines.zh: 你自己留着吧，苦难沼泽的泥够我吃。
lines.en: Keep it; Miserable Mire mud is enough for me.

lines.zh: 两格宽的鱼，二十点护甲。
lines.en: A two-block fish with twenty armor.
It's slowly sinking down.
This little thing is sinking down.
You hit my thick hide.
I didn't shift an inch.
The rebound pushed you back.
The water heaved from the impact.
My body is very heavy.
Your arm must be numb from that.
I slowly shifted to one side.
You stepped on my tail fin.
I can't be bothered with you.
I'm still in this water.
This pool is wide enough.
Let's each keep to one side.
Your fins are narrower than mine.
Two big fish crowding together.
I lean against this stone.
There's food here for two.
Swim over from that side.
Neither of us moves much.
Just staying quiet like this.
The water will hide us both.
It bumped against my teeth.
This mouth of mine never bites.
This isn't something to swallow.
You dropped this in the water.
I circled right around it.
It's gone soft from soaking.
I didn't bite it.
This meat drifted over. It's mine.
You've churned the water too much.

lines.zh: 我从泥里抬起头，看向你。
lines.en: I lift my head from the mud and look at you.
Mud billows up under the surface.

lines.zh: 宽鳍一张，浑水往两边分。
lines.en: My broad fins spread and the muddy water parts.
You're standing in the shallows.
The water's neither deep nor shallow.
I press over toward you.
This time I move first.
Now will do.
I push along the bottom.
Only a strip of my back shows.
You can't move fast in that mud.
I hear you pushing the water.
You've trampled the waterweed.

lines.zh: 我这么大，一口下去却不疼。
lines.en: This big, yet my bite is nothing.
You've backed to the fallen log.
That log won't stop me.
The water's getting murkier.
I just passed by your feet.
I swing my flank into you.
You're knocked back into the water.
I drive at you mouth open.
Your armor got caved in.
The spray went up high.
I turn back, fins still spread.
I didn't hit at full force.
I told you not to poke me.
I rise up from the muddy bottom.
The pool clouds up at once.
My back breaks the surface.
The weeds bend where I shove through.
Tree shadows fall across the bank.
I swing my tail twice.
The mud here is soft and deep.
I swing my head slowly round.
The insects have all scattered.
I start moving toward the shallows.
The surface grew scalding hot.
I crashed into the water, spraying high.
Too shallow to even turn over.
The blast threw up the whole pool.

lines.zh: 一根锋利的东西扎进背。
lines.en: Something sharp drove into my back.
That force left the water tingling.
There's little left to eat in here.
The current bites me through the water.
The water vanished all at once.
